seed_sweep.caveat: One frozen data snapshot; seeds are not independent market samples. Observational decomposition does not establish causal attribution to reward. MC probabilities are uncalibrated; no winner is chosen or promoted.

reproducibility: Seed sweep used a regenerated causal Parquet and pandas 2.2.3; archived bundle was trained with pandas 2.3.3. Input hashes differ. Compare seeds within their shared runtime/input; do not equate the local seed42 retraining with the archived model. Audit uses original bundle prices/features and normalizer; no holdout outcomes are evaluated.
